enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Humanoid Bane 4: This weapon is attuned specifically to those that walk among us, dealing an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Humanoids.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +17 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Mortal Strike: On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this weapon triggers the Slay Living spell and attempts to instantly snuff out the life force of the enemy (DC 17).
